target_customer: Friends and small groups who want a persistent, customizable place to hang out over video
problem: Zoom style video calls felt ephemeral and impersonal during the pandemic; Here offered persistent decorated rooms where friends watch, play and hang out.
business_model: consumer social app, model undecided at launch (options named were paid event payments, paywalled room persistence and virtual goods)

founders.name: Seth Harris
prior_employers: Groupon (VP of POS and Payments Product)
previous_startups: Breadcrumb (hospitality point of sale, acquired by Groupon)
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page; he also owned and operated Manhattan bars and restaurants.

founders.name: Jesse Boyes
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Human-computer liaison. TechCrunch names him and Harris as the founders and says they were friends for years.

exit.reason: The revived here.fm site says the original Here closed in 2024; no reason is stated.

competitors.name: mmhmm
competitors.what: Virtual camera and room customization focused on presenting
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as the closest comparison; no figures given

competitors.name: Macro
competitors.what: Tool layered on Zoom to make meetings more productive

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time video and voice in the browser with a shared interactive canvas needed WebRTC engineering and custom infrastructure, which the company later said it built itself.

defensibility.rationale: TechCrunch noted dozens of pandemic video chat startups and no business model had been chosen; switching costs were low.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zoom remained dominant after the pandemic; no source shows an incumbent buying or copying Here specifically.

market_need_then: Pandemic video fatigue and demand for social video; at launch TechCrunch reported thousands of rooms created and an average session of 41 minutes.

branding.domain_note: Company is Here.fm and the product is called Here; used the .fm domain rather than here.com. The article does not explain the name.

identity.visual_style: Decorated rooms with stickers, GIFs, backgrounds and notes on an infinite canvas.
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful and casual, centered on friends hanging out.

branding.brand_signature: Rooms friends decorate with stickers and a shared canvas.
branding.community_and_virality: A revived version of the site is run by the community on Discord after the original closed in 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: The decorated room concept was distinctive and covered by TechCrunch, but the name is a common word that is hard to search, and no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Here raised a 2.9 million dollar seed from FirstMark and YC in October 2020, two months after launch, with founders who had not chosen a business model. The original product closed in 2024 according to the revived site, but no reporting or post-mortem explains why, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty. Consumer video chat faced Zoom and many pandemic era entrants, but no source ties the closure to that.
notes: Total funding of about $3M from an aggregator fits the single seed round. Search also surfaced a coverager item 'Here raises $5 million' and startupintros items for a 2022 Here seed, but they were not opened and may concern other companies named Here, so no later round is recorded; gap not resolved. The FirstMark announcement page returned 403. The shutdown fact comes from the revived site, which says accounts were not carried over and does not name the team. YC directory stage is Growth and team size 9.
